description.value: Westcoast Fishing Adventures is a locally owned and operated guided fly-fishing and eco-tour company with over 30 years of experience on the Skeena, Nass, and Kitimat river systems of Northwest BC. Operated by Gill and Mandi McKean out of Lakelse River Lodge near Terrace, they offer tailored steelhead and salmon packages as well as 'Terradise Eco-Tours' that can include hiking, bear viewing, kayaking, and downhill biking. The operation emphasizes small group sizes, Indigenous relationships, and access to some of BC's most remote and pristine fisheries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides clear evidence that Westcoast Fishing Adventures is an active, locally-owned guided fishing and eco-tour operation based at Lakelse River Lodge, 908 Matson Road, Terrace, BC. The OSM record has no tags beyond name and coordinates, so all contact details and amenity evidence come from the website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the eco-tours page lists 'Downhill biking' as a possible activity, but this does not constitute evidence of cyclist-support infrastructure.
concerns: OSM record has no tags and no address or phone — all contact details sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
OSM coordinates (54.475, -128.610) place the point roughly near Terrace, BC, which is consistent with the lodge address, but the exact pin location has not been independently verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable business in Northwest BC; eco-tours include downhill biking as an optional activity making it tangentially relevant to cycling tourists exploring the region.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Terradise Eco-Tours page explicitly lists 'Downhill biking' among possible guided activities, which may be of interest to touring cyclists seeking guided adventure add-ons.

wow_evidence: 30-year guided fly-fishing and eco-tour operator on the Skeena/Nass/Kitimat systems; a guided steelhead or eco day is day-shaping.
